name: Christmas – Bookish Plot Twist: I Stayed In
story: Plot twist: I stayed in. A bookish ornament for the reader whose best holiday plan is a chair, a stack of books and the cat. A striped armchair, a crocheted blanket, a steaming mug on top of the books, a lamp glowing beside a sleeping cat: the whole scene is on a deep navy disc, with PLOT TWIST: in cream above it and I STAYED IN in mustard gold below.

It is the small, funny gift for the book club friend, the sister who cancels every party for a paperback, or the coworker who has never once been sorry to skip the office mixer. Hang it on the tree, loop it onto a wrapped present, or tuck it in a stocking next to a good bookmark.

The joke lands without any backstory: everyone who has ever turned down plans for a quiet evening with a novel knows exactly who this one is for. The design matches our Plot Twist oversized sweatshirt and cropped hoodie, so a reader can wear the line and hang it too. Each Graphic Tees Co. ornament is printed on glossy ceramic and made to order.
joke_a: The ornament says PLOT TWIST: I STAYED IN above and below a striped armchair with a stack of books, a mug, a lamp and a sleeping cat. It is the joke every reader tells when the big holiday plan is a chair and a book. Graphic Tees Co. prints it in cream and mustard gold on a navy disc.
